codeReview.summary: The fix fully addresses the original blocking portability defect. The original harness hard-coded `/Users/treygoff/Code/prospera-team-dashboard` in `playwright.config.js`, which made `npx playwright test` dependent on one specific checkout path. The fix replaces that with dynamically derived paths: `playwright.config.js` now serves `path.resolve(__dirname)`, `.factory/init.sh` resolves the repo root relative to the script location, and `.factory/services.yaml` serves `$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`. Together these changes remove the machine-specific path assumption while preserving the existing port-3100 startup model and harness behavior.
